tips.text: Rank Bo, Kunai and Tipedo to 30 before consuming each; mastery counts only for levels you earned.
Feed Lesion a fresh Tipedo with no Forma or Catalyst; they do not carry over from the consumed weapon.
Keep Bo, Kunai and Tipedo instead of selling them for slots; rebuying costs another 12 to 24 hours.
Start Bo and Kunai at the same time so the first stage takes 12 hours, not 24.
Build the base Tipedo; Tipedo Prime will not stand in as the Lesion ingredient.
Queue the chain from the companion app so you skip logging in for every stage.
Remove an installed Incarnon Genesis from Bo or Kunai before consuming it, or build a separate copy.
People call the chain tedious rather than hard; it is credits, four foundry timers and no RNG.
